Parses Claude Code JSONL sessions and Aider chat history markdown. Re-importing the same file is safe -- duplicate detection via content hashing prevents double imports.

## LLM-Powered Summarization

When an Anthropic API key is configured, engram sends a condensed transcript to Claude during import to generate high-quality summaries, interpreted goals, dead ends, and decisions. Without an API key, engram falls back to heuristic pattern extraction (still useful, but less nuanced).

```bash
# Set your API key (stored in ~/.config/engram/repos.toml, 0600 permissions)
engram config set anthropic_api_key sk-ant-api03-...

# Or use an environment variable (takes precedence)
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-...

# Optionally override the model (default: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001)
engram config set summarize_model claude-sonnet-4-20250514
```

LLM insights are merged with heuristic-extracted ones, so no extracted insight is lost. The API key is masked in output (`sk-a...03-x`) and the config file is owner-readable only.

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: comprehensive bug fixes, security hardening, and capture improvements (v0.3.0)

- Fix 8 UTF-8 panics on multi-byte chars across notes, importers, audit, stats, config, summarize
- Fix Write tool always classified as Created; now upgrades to Modified when Edit follows
- Fix dedup_by without sort in extractor (missed non-adjacent duplicates)
- Fix push_engrams reporting total refs instead of delta
- Fix DOT output quote injection in graph model
- Fix dashboard binding 0.0.0.0 -> 127.0.0.1 and restrict CORS to localhost
- Fix dashboard parse_note_header panic on malformed input
- Fix CSV injection in audit (unquoted author field)
- Fix Python SDK Operations.from_dict() dropping tool_calls/shell_commands
- Fix TUI terminal state not restored on panic (added panic hook)
- Fix EngramId From<String> bypassing validation (changed to TryFrom)
- Fix summarize test failing when global config has API key
- Expand heuristic extractor from 7 to 25+ dead-end/decision patterns
- Add Bash command tracking as shell_commands in capture pipeline
- Add tool error -> dead end capture from tool_result errors
- Improve summary fallback (last assistant text instead of truncated request)
- Filter generic interpreted_goal responses ("I'll help", "Sure,", etc.)
- Merge LLM insights with heuristic insights instead of replacing
- Add pricing for claude-haiku-4, o1-mini, o3-mini, o4-mini models
- Add MultiEdit tool tracking in file change classification
- Add search index debug logging for missing index directory
- Update README: add config/audit/browse/dashboard commands, dashboard+tui crates,
  LLM summarization docs, upgrade instructions, correct test count (179)
- Remove unused TypeScript SDK import
- Bump version to 0.3.0 across Cargo.toml, Python, TypeScript SDKs

179 tests passing, clippy clean, 0 warnings.

Co-Authored-By: claude-flow <ruv@ruv.net>
EOF
)"
